UPSTREAM: staging: sync: Protect unlocked access to fence status Fence status is checked outside of locks in both sync_fence_wait and sync_fence_poll. This patch adds propper barrier protection in these cases to avoid seeing stale status. UPSTREAM: staging: sync: Update new fence status with sync_fence_signal_pt If a fence's pt is signaled before sync_fence_create is called, the fence will never transition into the signaled state. This also address a tiny race if a merged fence's pt after sync_fence_get_status checks it's status and before fence->status is updated.
